about: Quest Log 'Also open' door lines, 2026-10-28 (Dave: yes to a second pass on doors). 74 lines → plain instructions; notes per door in doors-out (scratch). old must match live.

line.old: Pearl will feed you whether or not you're hungry. Ask who the corner table is for.
line.new: Stop in at Pearl's Diner in Chuckle Creek and talk to the owner.

line.old: The creek actually chuckles. Stand in it and see if it's laughing with you.
line.new: Go down to the creek in Chuckle Creek and stand in it a while.

line.old: Hollis will take an anvil for you. He will not take a question.
line.new: Find Hollis Bandy in Chuckle Creek and talk to him.

line.old: Captain Falk will take your edges. He will give you a receipt. The receipt is foam.
line.new: Go through the checkpoint at Soft Landing and talk to Captain Falk.

line.old: Seven candles, still lit. Make a wish and watch where it goes.
line.new: Find the cake in Soft Landing and make a wish.

line.old: The hum under everything. Put your hand on it. Don't turn it off. Somebody will.
line.new: Go under the streets of Soft Landing and find the blower.

line.old: Foam mantelpieces and no photographs. Ask for the oldest thing in the house.
line.new: Accept an invitation into one of the houses in Soft Landing.

line.old: Five cents. He takes marks. He gives change in buttons.
line.new: Buy a lemonade at the stand in Stillwater.

line.old: One bench, one clock, one board that says ARRIVING. Check your own watch.
line.new: Visit the train platform in Stillwater.

line.old: Everybody waves. Wave back. See what the third wave does.
line.new: Walk through Stillwater and wave back at the townsfolk.

line.old: Father Tamsin has a night story and a kettle. Sit with him a while. Don't ask him for a metaphor.
line.new: Visit Father Tamsin in Allesh-Gilliam and sit with him a while.

line.old: Etta said questions keep. They've kept. Bring money for preserves; the answer comes after the jar.
line.new: Visit the Long Market in Allesh-Gilliam and talk to Etta Bloom.

line.old: Captain Brakk is drilling farmers by the North Gate. Compliments will be issued as citations.
line.new: Go to the Muster at the old fire station by the North Gate in Allesh-Gilliam and meet Captain Brakk.

line.old: The River Heart lies open to the south — collapsed, so the whole of it shows on the map. Its towns are not quests you accept; they are places you go. Ride there and they will meet you.
line.new: Ride south into the River Heart and visit its towns.

line.old: Calder talks while he works. Ask how deep it goes. If you sit down he stops, so don't.
line.new: Go to the Brace in Khezek-Tor and talk to Foreman Drax Calder.

line.old: Sable Nine has a point on the map that won't hold still. Bring your own chair.
line.new: Go to the Maw in Khezek-Tor and talk to Sable Nine.

line.old: Brennig runs the crates from a desk built out of two pallets and a door. Count the places at the cookline on your way in.
line.new: Visit the Lift Hall in Khezek-Tor.

line.old: Only once you know what you're looking at. Then the courier's route, at a respectful distance.
line.new: Follow the courier's route up to the Upper Galleries of Khezek-Tor. Keep your distance.

line.old: There's a Chupacabra behind the bar. Oh shit. He's the bartender. Order something before you interrogate him.
line.new: Go into the Gullywasher at the Fixit Farm and order a drink from the bartender.

line.old: The Counter quotes weight, not price. Ask Mara what her biggest headache is.
line.new: Go to the Counter at the Fixit Farm and talk to Mara.

line.old: Pip and Patter move in synch with everything that moves. Ask what's moving near Allesh. Both will answer, at once.
line.new: Find Pip and Patter at the Fixit Farm and ask what's moving near Allesh-Gilliam.

line.old: OFF LIMITS. SCRAM. Except Stewards, once the Jackalopes call you allies.
line.new: Climb the back stairs at the Fixit Farm. As allies of the Jackalopes, you're welcome up.

line.old: Escort only. It's not personal. Allies get the tour.
line.new: Take Patter's tour of the Generator Hall at the Fixit Farm.

line.old: AS IS. NO REFUNDS. STOP ASKING. Pat it first.
line.new: Try the MYSTERY Bin by the Counter at the Fixit Farm.

line.old: The Water Choir is tuning to you. Stand in it and listen. The children will grade you.
line.new: Visit the Water Choir in the channels at Lyrenn and listen.

line.old: Elsin will answer what you ask. She'd rather answer it once. Ask about the vault and watch her not ask back.
line.new: Talk to Elsin Quade in Lyrenn.

line.old: Rowan is listening to the ground. Ask what's loud. Then ask what's quiet.
line.new: Find Rowan of the Loam in the fields at Lyrenn and ask what's loud.

line.old: The Green Ring listens. Walk it. Mind the plinth.
line.new: Walk the Green Ring around the old grain elevator in Lyrenn.

line.old: The marsh applauds everything. Bow three times and see what the third bow does.
line.new: Step out into the marsh at Gloomgill and take a bow.

line.old: He knows the answers before he asks them. The GM is holding the ledger.
line.new: Look at the scoreboard at Gloomgill.

line.old: Bev has terms. Ask before you assume.
line.new: Visit Chairperson Laser Bev in her office at the Crown Mall.

line.old: He's been watching you skate. Run it back.
line.new: Find Kickflip Lazarus by the skate rails at the Crown Mall and talk to him.

line.old: She sells context. Ask what's in rare inventory.
line.new: Visit Miss June of the Endcap at the Crown Mall and ask what she sells.

line.old: Late fees are still accruing. Bring the slip.
line.new: Go to Crown Mall Video with Kickflip. Bring the rental slip if you have it.

line.old: Visit the Founders' Garden. One hundred figures in living stone. The exit may not exist.
line.new: Read the Route Board at the Crown Mall.

line.old: A man with a broom is losing an argument with a floor plan. Ask him which way it faced that night.
line.new: Visit the Rotating Chapel and talk to the keeper.

line.old: The harbourmaster keeps a ledger of everything that leaves. Ask what never comes back full.
line.new: Go to Fewer Dead Fish Smell, the saloon at Port Kudzu, and talk to Harbourmaster Dot Pellew.

line.old: If you know when the wagon leaves, be on it. You are salt. Be convincing salt.
line.new: Be at Port Kudzu when the supply wagon leaves, and ride it.

line.old: Where the wagon goes. Wick will be on time. Say the kettle.
line.new: Go to the camp where the wagon unloads, on the Khezek-Tor switchbacks.

line.old: Files are never closed. Bring receipts to Legansus and ask to be reclassified.
line.new: Bring your receipts to the Circuit Riders at the Legansus Waystation for a second hearing.

line.old: A freighter across the road, rigged in one colour. Ask about the other one.
line.new: Find Korl's freighter where it came down on the road and talk to the crew.

line.old: Silly hats, vests, and a vigil for a number. Sox will shush you and then help.
line.new: Approach the camp of locals near the Door in the Hill.

line.old: Runners are never late, never lost, never off the check-in. One of them is all three. Mara has one sentence about it.
line.new: Hear Mara out at the Fixit Farm. One of the runners is missing.

line.old: Captain Robot has a crew, and each of them has a question for you. Ask them theirs.
line.new: Talk to Captain Robot at the Circuit Riders' camp.

line.old: Simone checks whether you lag. Arvind hears patterns. Howard recovers things. Dennis is the regrettable hypothesis.
line.new: Meet Captain Robot's crew: Simone, Arvind, Howard and Dennis.

line.old: You do not get to witness their burden casually. You will be told when you may look. Then stay for the whole pattern.
line.new: Ask Captain Robot to show you what the Riders see. Stay until they're done.

line.old: Verified coordinates, verified need, no theatrics. Every receipt you hold is a filing. File it.
line.new: Bring your receipts to Captain Robot and file them the way a Rider would.

line.old: It is the size of a skyscraper and it is nervous. Wave. It will be so relieved.
line.new: Go see the Colossus at the Circuit Riders' camp.

line.old: Dougan pours before he answers. Order something. Ask who kept staging it.
line.new: Go to the Gullywasher and talk to Dougan.

line.old: They will hand you back something you never dropped. Say thank you. They're being thorough.
line.new: When the Road Wendigo meet you on the road, stop and talk with them.

line.old: It's under four feet of lit water and nobody has read it. Wade out. Settle nothing.
line.new: Wade out to the town sign in Probably Beaumont.

line.old: Rerouting is now mandatory. Thank it for its patience. Ask it what it's trying to finish.
line.new: Go to the Dispatcher's Booth in Maybe Beaumont and talk to the dispatcher.

line.old: Sign the book after, not before. Before is bragging.
line.new: Visit the sexton in the Northreach Expanse.

line.old: Six points that never moved. Two of them circled in a hand that shook.
line.new: Meet Sable Nine on the mountain road and look at their chart.

line.old: Level chair, unlevel ground, forty re-levellings, one thermos. He'll offer you coffee.
line.new: Talk to the man in the lawn chair on the Balcones fault line.

line.old: It insists it was always over there. Check the survey. Believe the creek.
line.new: Check the creek on the Balcones against the geologist's survey.

line.old: The counterweight tower has a school in it and the school has a bell and the bell has never been late. Ask the girl what would happen if it were.
line.new: Visit the school in the counterweight tower and talk to the girl on bell duty.

line.old: Sal Tench counts the moorings before answering anything. Count them yourself: who ties up next to whom is this month's map.
line.new: Go to the Stilt-Hall and talk to Sal Tench.

line.old: Wick has a slate and odds. EMPTY is forty to one and has one bet on it. Ask whose.
line.new: Go to the Vacancy and look at the betting slate on the gift.

line.old: There is a cigar box under the manifests that nobody discusses. Every card is in one hand.
line.new: Look in the Cadence's stores and talk to the quartermaster.

line.old: After the floor there are refreshments. Ask the Maestra, with no angle at all, what the drum was for. Her crew will watch you like incoming fire.
line.new: Stay for refreshments after the floor and talk to the Maestra.

line.old: The Cadence owes you a Battle. Name the target when you need morale like a weather system.
line.new: Call in the Battle the Cadence owes you. Name the target before the fight.

line.old: It holds up signs the way other people hold up hands. Say thank you and see what it holds up next.
line.new: Find the Tree Person in the Forest of Early Tifaret.

line.old: Walk it once, saying nothing. A branch will let go of a leaf it has been holding for some time.
line.new: Walk the Ring in the Forest of Early Tifaret once, saying nothing.

line.old: FAMILY PRICING. The screws are new this century. Somebody comes here.
line.new: Read the sign at the mouth of the Founders' Garden.

line.old: Say what the gesture is. There is no right answer and the garden has waited two hundred years for the wrong ones.
line.new: Find the statue with the half-raised hand in the Founders' Garden and say what the gesture is.

line.old: At the Vacancy, THE ONE WE DON'T ASK ABOUT is made up every night now. Ask Verna why, not for whom.
line.new: Go to the Vacancy and ask Verna about the room she keeps made up.

line.old: Every plinth has a date scratched at its foot. Count them. None of them is the night itself. Except one.
line.new: Count the plinths in the Founders' Garden and read the dates at their feet.

line.old: The smooth line on the hill is a name. The Tamsins' paperwork from the night might hold it still long enough to read.
line.new: Bring the Service Manifest to the smooth line on the low hill in the Founders' Garden.

line.old: The Legansus fold was a gate order with a heading, and the heading was theirs. Arrive early. Nobody is early.
line.new: Use the Legansus gate order and step through the Leygate on its heading.

line.old: The bell works. Stand under the arch and count.
line.new: Before you commit, go to the Muster at the fire station and count who came.

line.old: Someone keeps the same distance behind you, leg after leg. Wave. See what happens. See what doesn't.
line.new: Deal with the walker who keeps forty paces behind you on the road.

line.old: When one of yours dies, the bees have to be told. Full sentences, the name, the date.
line.new: If one of your people dies, visit the house with the six hives behind it.

line.old: Poor, clean, swept, nobody home. Noted.
line.new: Look at the low house beside the road.
